name: LTX Render to Real
description: Turn a 3D / CG / game render into a photorealistic video. Feed in your render and LTX-2.3 re-renders it with realistic lighting, materials, and detail (optionally anchored to a first-frame reference image).

action.description: Turn a 3D / CG / game render into a photorealistic video. Feed in your render and LTX-2.3 re-renders it with realistic lighting, materials, and detail (optionally anchored to a first-frame reference image).
action.name: fal-ai/ltx-2.3-quality/render-to-real
action.searchText: ltx render to real  ltx lightricks render to real 3d to real cg to real photoreal render video_to_video render-to-real 3dreal

detail_refine_strength.description: Denoise strength of the detailer pass, used only when Detail Refine is on. Higher regenerates more detail; lower stays closer to the base.
detail_refine_strength.title: Detail Refine Strength

enable_detail_refine.description: Add a second refinement stage for a sharper, higher-resolution result. This doubles output width and height (4x the pixels), so it costs roughly 4x and is slower.
enable_detail_refine.title: Detail Refine

enable_prompt_expansion.description: When on, an AI model expands your prompt into a richer description before generation. The 3DREAL trigger is always kept.
enable_prompt_expansion.title: Prompt Expansion

frames_per_second.description: Frames per second of the generated video.
frames_per_second.title: Frames Per Second

generate_audio.description: Include an audio track in the returned video. When off, the final MP4 has no audio.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. The default is tuned for fast, high-quality generation.
guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale

intensity.description: How hard to push the render toward photorealism. 'light' keeps more of the source look and motion; 'strong' transforms more aggressively; 'strong-v2' is the newest adapter with better coherence, audio, and quality.
intensity.title: Intensity

num_frames.description: Number of output frames. Output duration is num_frames / fps. The control budget caps resolution x frames (roughly 6s at 720p or 15s at 480p).
num_frames.title: Number of Frames

num_inference_steps.description: Number of inference steps. Higher can improve quality at the cost of speed.
num_inference_steps.title: Inference Steps

resolution.description: Output resolution (short side). Resolution trades against duration: 720p allows up to ~6s, 480p up to ~15s. Requests above the budget are rejected.
resolution.title: Resolution

video_quality.description: The quality preset of the generated video.
video_quality.title: Video Quality

video_write_mode.description: The write mode of the generated video.
video_write_mode.title: Video Write Mode
